extracted.intended_audience: applicants seeking registration or reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; patent practitioners interacting with OED
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and evidentiary/fee requirements for filing an application for registration or reinstatement to practice before the USPTO (including previously suspended or disbarred practitioners), and grounds on which OED will deem an application incomplete or deny admission. Focuses on compliance with 37 C.F.R. requirements and documentary proof of fitness to practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Possess good moral character and reputation
rubrics_metrics.description: An applicant must establish to the satisfaction of the OED Director that he or she possess good moral character and reputation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cites 37 C.F.R. § 11.7(a)(2). Moral character and reputation are required elements for registration/reinstatement and are assessed in light of prior discipline or misconduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Possess legal, scientific, and technical qualifications and competence
rubrics_metrics.description: An applicant must possess the legal, scientific, and technical qualifications necessary to render applicants valuable service and be competent to advise and assist applicants before the Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cites 37 C.F.R. § 11.7(a)(2). Competence is a standalone requirement alongside character and reputation for practicing before the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment of applicable application and examination fees (previously suspended practitioners)
rubrics_metrics.description: A previously suspended practitioner filing an application for registration must pay the fee schedule as set forth in 37 C.F.R. § 1.21(a)(1)(ii) and (a)(10) (including a $1,600.00 application fee for previously suspended practitioners) and the applicable examination registration fee ($200.00 or $450.00).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must check the correct boxes on the application (8a and 8b) to indicate payment method and examination administration; failure to pay the requisite fees will render the application incomplete and result in denial. The $40.00 reinstatement fee (37 C.F.R. § 1.21(a)(3)) is not a substitute for these required fees for previously suspended practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to take and pass the registration examination for reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: One condition precedent to reinstatement for previously suspended practitioners is taking and passing the registration examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cites 37 C.F.R. § 10.160(c)(1) and related USPTO decisions. Any prior passing of the examination before suspension does not satisfy this requirement; the applicant must demonstrate passing the exam after meeting the reinstatement conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide full and complete copy of disciplinary proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: An individual who has been disbarred, suspended, or resigned in lieu of disciplinary proceeding shall provide a full and complete copy of the proceedings that led to the disbarment, suspension, or resignation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cites 37 C.F.R. § 11.7(b)(4)(i). Documentary submission of prior proceedings is a required part of the reinstatement application packet and necessary to assess moral character and fitness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document affirmative background answers with detailed statements and verified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: For each background question answered 'Yes,' provide a detailed statement setting forth all relevant facts and dates along with verified copies of relevant documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically referenced with respect to Questions 15 and 18 (disciplinary/charges history and employment discipline/resignation for dishonesty or violations). Failure to provide these statements and verified documents will render the application incomplete.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct completion of application form (do not alter form language or rely on handwritten modifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must properly complete the official application form and may not substitute handwritten alterations to the form language in lieu of complying with required entries and checkboxes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petitioner's handwritten modifications (e.g., altering 'Reinstatement' language) were not treated as satisfying regulatory requirements. Use the form's designated entries (e.g., 8a and 8b) and follow instructions exactly.

rubrics_metrics.name: No waivers of fee or examination requirements based on disability, military status, or inability to pay
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no waiver provision under 37 C.F.R. § 11.2(c) for fees or examination requirements; neither military status, disability, nor claimed inability to pay excuses compliance with fee or exam requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims seeking waiver of fees or exam requirements on such grounds are without merit under the cited regulations and USPTO practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Failure to submit required fees or documentation results in application incompleteness and denial
rubrics_metrics.description: If required fees are not paid and required documentary information is not provided, the application will be deemed incomplete and will not be further considered (denial of admission).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OED staff issued a Notice of Incompleteness and Denial where the applicant failed to pay required fees and failed to provide documentation for affirmative background answers; the Director affirmed denial based on these deficiencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior suspension/discipline must be disclosed but does not eliminate procedural requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: A history of suspension/discipline is relevant to assessing moral character and must be disclosed with documentary proof, but prior complaints or ongoing Inspector General inquiries do not excuse meeting reinstatement requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision notes that earlier suspension facts were not disputed, but that contesting the initial suspension or citing pending complaints has no bearing on current compliance obligations for reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting all reinstatement conditions is required before reinstatement will be granted
rubrics_metrics.description: Reinstatement is contingent on meeting every regulatory condition; mere acceptance of an 'offer' to take the registration examination or isolated compliance does not automatically effect reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quoting prior OED decisions: 'Petitioner's acceptance of the USPTO "offer" to take the test is of no legal effect. The USPTO will reinstate [an applicant] if he meets all the requirements for reinstatement as previously outlined to him.'
